projects.title: Fatis 1.0 - An holistic and aesthetic inspiration board for artists
projects.summary: Fatis is a platform for creative and artists where they can share and collect other human made art.
projects.content: Fatis is a platform for creative and artists where they can share and collect other human made art. It is similar to other platforms like pinterest or artstation but it focuses more on the user interactions and letting them find what they realy want in a more precise fashion. Hyperfast searching, suggestions, and a easier UX is what differs.
